retrieval_config.description: Module-based retrieval priority for legal documents.

priority_order.label: binding_local
priority_order.description: Karnataka Rent Act / amendments — preferred for Karnataka property cases

priority_order.label: binding_national
priority_order.description: Transfer of Property Act, Indian Contract Act, Specific Relief Act, BNS — binding nationally

priority_order.label: reference
priority_order.description: Model Tenancy Act — reference only; never binding in Karnataka

Module A — Security deposit recovery.instruction: Always prefer Karnataka Rent Act Sections 15/16 over Model Tenancy Act Section 11 in Karnataka. Do NOT declare painting deductions automatically illegal — check wear/tear vs contractual liability.

Module B — Unlawful rent increase.instruction: Use agreement clause + Karnataka Rent Act Section 7/Section 9 first. Section 106 governs termination notice, not a general 90-day rent-increase notification rule — do not assume that violation automatically.

Module C — Emergency eviction / utility.instruction: Section 6 of Specific Relief Act applies only with its statutory conditions. BNS applies only where documented criminal conduct exists. Always refer DLSA 080-22939213 / Police 112 for immediate danger; use verified Rent Controller details only from official DPAL/revenue notifications.

separation_note: This index is the structured retrieval config. It does NOT replace the vector store (kb/). The orchestrator should read this before retrieving chunks to set module filters.
